transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... well, I guess I'm here because... it's hard to explain. I just feel like the warm part of me kind of... shut off. Like, I'll sit with my husband, or try to watch my shows after work, and I know I should feel comfort, or even a little happy. But... I don't know. There's just nothing there.
When did you first notice this feeling of emptiness?
About... three weeks ago, I think. Um... there was an accident at work. A pallet collapsed and... it injured one of my coworkers. I guess it just started after that.
Are you still able to enjoy things you normally liked before this feeling started, like hobbies or spending time with friends?
I... I don't really know. I haven't really tried to do much of anything lately. Just... going to work and coming home, mostly. I haven't really seen anyone.
Were you feeling sad or down before the accident at work happened?
Um... no. Not really. I was... just normal, I guess. Everything was fine before that.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or look forward to?

Um... no. Not really. I think... that's kind of what made me come in here. I just feel like the... the warm part of me just shut off. Like, I'll sit with my husband, or just try to watch my shows after my shift, and... I know I should feel some comfort, or at least a little happy. But... there's just nothing there.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
Yeah... I guess so. Like I was just saying, I... I don't really care about doing much of anything right now.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future?
I don't know... I haven't really thought about the future much. Just... trying to get through the week, I guess. So, no, not really.
Have you been experiencing any changes in your appetite or sleep patterns since you started feeling this way?

Um... eating is about the same, I guess. But sleep... not really. I'm usually exhausted after my late shift, but... I just lie there. Every time I start to drift off, I jerk awake. I keep thinking I hear the pallets shifting. And if I do manage to sleep... I just wake up feeling like I never really rested anyway.
Have you been experiencing any thoughts of death or suicidal ideas?
No. I haven't... I don't think about that.
Do you feel like your lack of interest in activities and feelings of emptiness are interfering with your daily life?

I guess so. I mean... I'm not even doing my regular receiving work right now. I was doing a pallet move the other day and I just... froze up. And then I snapped at one of the guys. 

My supervisor ended up pulling me off the floor. He said I wasn't functioning safely out there. So... yeah. It is.
Do you feel like your current state is significantly worse than your normal low points?
I don't really know. Um... I haven't really thought about it like that. I guess it's just... different. I mean, I don't usually get pulled off the floor, so... maybe. I'm not sure.
How many days in a row have you been feeling this way?
Um... I guess about three weeks. Just... ever since that pallet collapsed. The one that... that injured my coworker. So, yeah. About three weeks.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty about anything since the accident happened?
I don't know. I mean... I guess I just try not to think about it too much. It's just... it happened. I don't really know what else to say about it.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight since you started feeling this way?
Um... no, not really. I haven't really been paying attention to that. I don't think anything's changed.
Have you lost any significant amount of weight since the accident happened?
I mean, like I just said... no. I don't think so. I haven't really been checking the scale or anything, so... probably not.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure most of the day?

Um... yeah, I guess. Honestly... that's kind of why I came in. It just feels like... like the warm part of me shut off. I'll sit with my husband after work, or try to watch my shows, and I know I should feel... I don't know, comfort, or a little happy. But... there's just nothing there.
Do you feel sad most of the day?
Um... no. Not really sad. I don't... I don't cry a lot or anything. It's just... more like what I was just saying. Just kind of blank, I guess.
Do you feel sad most of the day, even if it's just a little?
I mean... no. Like I just said. It's not really sadness. Just... I don't know. Just blank.
Do you feel depressed most of the day?
I don't... I don't think so. Not depressed. It's really just... what I said before. Just nothing.
Do you feel depressed?
I... no. Like I just said, I don't.
